name: Mnyamawamtuka
sum: Mnyamawamtuka is a lithostrotian titanosaur from the Cretaceous Galula Formation of Tanzania, known from a skeleton found in 2004.
wsnote: Estimated length and weight of the holotype individual (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: RRBP 05834, a disarticulated skeleton from the Mtuka Member, most likely 110-100 Ma.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Gorscak and O'Connor 2019

sources.text: Gorscak, Eric; O'Connor, Patrick M. 2019. A new African titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur from the middle Cretaceous Galula Formation (Mtuka Member), Rukwa Rift Basin, southwestern Tanzania. PLoS ONE 2(14). doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0211412
